integrity: Self-contained four-step analytic proof and independently rerunnable finite-size numerical consistency checker; broad random-unitary attractor literature may contain related implied statements.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple graphs; strictly interior independent edge probabilities; nonresonant positive switching times. Ensemble-averaged states only; no quantified mixing rate; no almost-sure pathwise statement.
title: Universal two-sector equilibration under dynamical bond percolation
